In the third quarter of 2026, the Company recorded $27.8 million of pre-tax acquisition-related costs associated with the Indicor acquisition, which are comprised of one-time transaction costs and ongoing integration costs. Integration costs of $9.8 million are recorded in Cost of sales and primarily include fair-value inventory adjustments. Transaction costs of $18.1 million are recorded in Other (expense) income, net and primarily include representation and warranty insurance costs.

ga.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $225.5 million or 10.2% of net sales, an increase of $27.7 million or 14.0%, compared with $197.8 million or 10.4% of net sales for the third quarter of 2025. Selling expenses increased primarily due to the net sales increase discussed above. General and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $31.8 million, compared with $27.9 million for the third quarter of 2025.

intro.text: AMETEK, Inc. (“AMETEK” or the “Company”) is incorporated in Delaware. Its predecessor was originally incorporated in Delaware in 1930 under the name American Machine and Metals, Inc. AMETEK is a leading global manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices with operations in North America, Europe, Asia and South America. AMETEK maintains its principal executive offices at 1100 Cassatt Road, Berwyn, Pennsylvania, 19312. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: AME), the common stock of AMETEK is a component of the Standard and Poor’s 500 and the Russell 1000 Indices.

oi.text: Segment operating income for 2024 was $1,884.9 million, an increase of $77.4 million or 4.3%, compared with segment operating income of $1,807.5 million in 2023. Segment operating income, as a percentage of net sales, decreased to 27.2% in 2024, compared with 27.4% in 2023. Segment operating income and operating margins in 2024 included $29.2 million of integration costs related to the Paragon acquisition, which negatively impacted segment operating margins by 40 basis points. The dilutive impact of the 2023 acquisitions negatively impacted segment operating margins by 110 basis points in 2024. Excluding the dilutive impact of the 2023 acquisitions and the Paragon integration costs, segment operating margins increased 130 basis points compared to 2023, due to the continued benefits from the Company's Operational Excellence initiatives.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Income taxes payable, non-current
lines.why: Taxes on operating income due after a year (often uncertain tax positions): operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

accounts.name: Property, plant and equipment
accounts.note: Depreciation and amortisation includes the amortisation of intangibles where the filing reports one line: the PP&E residual then carries the intangibles' share.

accounts.name: Goodwill and intangibles
accounts.note: Acquisitions add goodwill and intangibles at their allocated values, not at the cash paid; the residual is the difference and the amortisation.

accounts.name: Equity
accounts.note: Other comprehensive income (currency translation, unrealised gains) moves equity without passing through net income: it is in the residual.

s.t: Process and analytical instrumentation sales represented 70% of EIG’s 2025 net sales.
Aerospace and Power Instrumentation sales represented 30% of EIG’s 2025 net sales.
Approximately 4% of EIG’s 2025 net sales were made to its five largest customers.
Automation and Engineered Solution sales represented 70% of EMG’s 2025 net sales.
Aerospace sales represented 30% of EMG’s 2025 net sales.
Approximately 15% of EMG’s 2025 net sales were made to its five largest customers.
No single customer comprises greater than 5% of net sales.
International sales for 2025 and 2024 represented 48.2% and 47.4% of our consolidated net sales, respectively.
Kern and FARO constituted 8.4% of total assets as of December 31, 2025 and 3.2% of net sales for the year then ended.

As indicated in the accompanying Management’s Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting , management’s assessment of and conclusion on the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting did not include the internal controls of Kern Microtechnik ("Kern") and FARO Technologies ("FARO"), which are included in the 2025 consolidated financial statements of the Company and constituted 8.4% of total assets as of December 31, 2025 and 3.2% of net sales for the year then ended.
